content: योजनम् [युज्-भावादौ ल्युट्] .²1 Joining, uniting, yoking. .²2 Applying, fixing. .²3 Preparation, arrangement. .²4 Grammatical construction, construing the sense of a passage. .²5 A measure of distance equal to four {%Krośas%} or eight or nine miles; स्याद् योजनं क्रोशचतुष्टयेन; प्रथममगमदह्ना योजने योजनेशः <ls>Līlā.</ls>; न योजनशतं दूरं वाह्यमानस्य तृष्णया <ls>H. 1. 146</ls>. .²6 Exciting, instigation. .²7 Concentration of the mind, abstraction (= योग <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²8 Erecting, constructing (also योजना in this sense). .²9 <ab>Ved.</ab> Effort, exertion. .²10 A road, way. .²11 The Supreme Spirit of the universe. .²12 A finger. .{@-ना@} .²1 Junction, union, connection. .²2 Grammatical construction. .²3 Use, application.
